summary: This is a takedown prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $60 million in common stock. INNO Holdings Inc. has engaged Aegis Capital Corp. as sales agent with a 3% commission. There are no fixed price, premium, offer structure, or deadline. The filing is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a transformative event. As a holding company with Hong Kong subsidiaries, it notes risks under PRC regulations. No watch/arb angle applies.
